layouts.description: Draft configuration: Figure-of-eight course follows the independently named Chicago, Hammerhead, Follow-through, Bentley, Bacharach, Gambon, Crooner and Wilson sections. The two loops meet at an actual shared source node; no edge is duplicated and no crossing or connecting coordinate is invented. This preserves the crossing that a simple-cycle search omitted. Source length 2808.1 m remains unadjusted. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2808.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
